Data from the Palmer Archipelago [@gorman2014].

```{r}
#| label: fig-mass
#| fig-cap: "Body mass by species."
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(penguins, aes(species, body_mass)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

As @fig-mass shows, Gentoo penguins are heavier.
